parsed.name: DXP软触发组件
parsed.description: 用于 DXP/MCA 采集系统的非实体软件触发组件。它在实验中负责为关联的 EPICS DXP 设备准备软触发采集流程、设置预设计数相关信号，并在进入 stage 时整理采集时间等阶段参数。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software trigger component for DXP/MCA acquisition systems. In laboratory use, it prepares soft-triggered acquisition for associated EPICS DXP devices, configures preset counting-related signals, and organizes staged acquisition parameters such as count time during staging.

actions.description: 获取关联 DXP 设备的底层参数值。
actions.description_en: Get a low-level parameter value from the associated DXP device.

actions.description: 为软触发采集进行预备配置，并在需要时整理阶段中的计数时间等设置信号。
actions.description_en: Prepare the soft-triggered acquisition configuration and manage staged settings such as count-time-related signals when needed.
